abstract: We study RPM and vertical integration in a common agency setting with two differentiated manufacturers and one retailer, where consumer demand depends on both the manufacturers' and retailer's noncontractible efforts. Under vertical separation, the adoption of maximum RPM by both manufacturers is an equilibrium and intensifies competition, since manufacturing margins are positive to incentivize manufacturing effort. This benefits consumers and may lower industry profits relative to a scenario where RPM is not available. Vertical integration between the retailer and one of the manufacturers increases industry profits and, when retail effort is also important, may benefit consumers by mitigating double marginalization.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两家差异化制造商和一家零售商的共同代理框架下的转售价格维持（RPM）与纵向一体化问题，其中消费者需求同时取决于制造商和零售商不可契约化的努力水平。在纵向分离情形下，两家制造商均采用最高转售价格维持构成均衡状态，并加剧了市场竞争——这是因为制造商需维持正利润空间以激励其努力投入。相较于无法实施RPM的情形，这种机制使消费者获益，但可能降低行业整体利润。当零售商与其中一家制造商实现纵向一体化时，行业利润得以提升；若零售努力同样重要，该模式还能通过缓解双重边际化效应使消费者受益。
title: RPM and Vertical Integration With Upstream Competition and Noncontractible Efforts
title_zh: 上游竞争与非契约努力下的转售价格维持与纵向整合

abstract: We study the global footprint and real effects of Chinese overseas corporate ownership. By assembling a comprehensive micro-level dataset of 161, 773 firms across 159 countries (2012–2021), we independently reconstruct multi-layered ownership chains to trace capital through offshore tax havens to its ultimate origin. This approach reveals a global footprint substantially broader than official FDI statistics. Chinese-controlled foreign assets expanded at 20% annually, reaching $2.1 trillion or roughly 3% of global corporate assets by 2021. Chinese investors—particularly state-owned enterprises (SOEs)—strategically target R&D-intensive and supply-chain-linked firms. Following acquisition, target firms increase capital stock and R&D expenditures, yet these inputs fail to generate higher patent output and are accompanied by a significant decline in profitability. We document a novel 'innovation spillback' mechanism: while target innovation remains stagnant, Chinese parent firms experience a sharp acceleration in granted patents following their first developed-economy acquisition. Furthermore, a greater Chinese presence crowds out R&D at non-target peer firms, though aggregate industry-level innovation remains unchanged. China thus represents a distinctively state-driven model of global ownership that accepts weaker near-term performance to internalize technological capacity at home.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国海外企业所有权的全球足迹及其实际影响。通过整合涵盖159个国家161,773家企业的微观数据集（2012-2021年），我们独立重构了多层所有权链条，以追溯资本通过离岸避税天堂流向最终来源的路径。这一方法揭示的全球足迹远超官方FDI统计数据。中国控制的海外资产以每年20%的速度扩张，到2021年达到2.1万亿美元，约占全球企业资产的3%。中国投资者——尤其是国有企业——战略性地瞄准研发密集型和供应链关联企业。在收购后，目标企业增加了资本存量和研发支出，但这些投入未能带来更高的专利产出，同时伴随着盈利能力的显著下降。我们记录了一种新颖的“创新回流”机制：尽管目标企业的创新停滞不前，但中国母公司在首次收购发达经济体企业后，其授权专利数量急剧加速增长。此外，中国企业的更大存在挤出了非目标同行企业的研发活动，尽管行业层面的总体创新水平保持不变。因此，中国代表了一种独特的国家驱动型全球所有权模式，该模式接受较弱的短期绩效，以将技术能力内部化至国内。

abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at an age, promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and produce evidence on dynamic complementarity and its three components using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.
abstract_zh: 动态互补性是指过去投资在某个年龄段形成更高技能存量，从而促进该年龄段投资带来的技能增长这一概念。我们利用中国农村地区针对幼儿家长的家访项目独特数据，对动态互补性及其三个组成部分进行了界定并提供了实证证据。此外，我们还研究了在没有任何正式干预的情况下，由先天因素、父母因素和环境因素导致的学习增长。

abstract: We document how foreign firms, inputs, and subsidies have shaped the development of Viet Nam's solar panel industry. We use firm-to-firm transaction data from Panjiva as well as firm-level data from the Vietnamese Enterprise Survey to trace solar panel value chains. We uncover three key findings: First, parts and components from subsidizing countries are 30% cheaper than alternatives. Those from China, which provides the majority of solar inputs to Vietnamese producers, are cheapest. Foreign subsidies may thus spill over across countries via value chains. Second, Chinese FDI firms dominate Viet Nam's solar industry, accounting for 75% of exports and 50% of jobs, while exporting solar panels that are 38% cheaper than those of other producers in Viet Nam. Third, local firms supplying parts and components to these Chinese FDI firms experience positive productivity gains. Our findings show how Viet Nam's solar boom emerged through deep integration into China's subsidized supply chains.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了外资企业、中间投入品及补贴如何塑造了越南太阳能光伏产业的发展格局。我们利用Panjiva的企业间交易数据以及越南企业调查的企业层面数据，追溯了太阳能光伏价值链的演变。研究得出三项核心发现：第一，来自补贴国的零部件价格比替代品低30%，而来自中国（越南太阳能投入品的主要供应国）的零部件价格最低。这表明外国补贴可能通过价值链产生跨国溢出效应。第二，中国外商直接投资企业在越南太阳能产业中占据主导地位，贡献了75%的出口额和50%的就业岗位，其出口的太阳能电池板价格比越南其他生产商低38%。第三，向这些中国外商直接投资企业供应零部件的本土企业实现了正向生产率提升。研究结论表明，越南太阳能产业的繁荣是通过深度融入中国补贴供应链实现的。

abstract: We revisit a long-held consensus that the number of county-level units in imperial China remained stable and consistently hovered around 1, 250 for two millennia. We argue that this consensus, traceable to G. W. Skinner 's influential introductory chapter in The City in Late Imperial China, focuses excessively on the county (xian), which exist ed throughout the imperial period, and overlooks other dynasty-specific types of field administration. During the Northern Song dynasty (960- 1127), alongside the predominantly rural counties, the state established various alternative types of field administration, most notably the towns (zhen), which administered urban households. Approximately 30% of the 1, 900 towns existing in the year 1084 were staffed by centrally-appointed bureaucrat s. These officials collect ed t axes, provided basic public services, interact ed with the population daily, and were directly account able to the prefect. Overlooking the existence of these towns means underestimating not only the scale of the Song field administration, but also its sophistication. Unlike later dynasties, the Song state differentiated between urban and rural settlements administratively, and its urban coverage was unsurpassed until the modern age. We trace the precocity of the Song system to institutional innovations during the two centuries of political fragmentation that preceded the Song dynasty.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了一个长期存在的共识：帝制中国县级行政单位的数量在两千年间保持稳定，始终徘徊在1250个左右。我们认为，这一可追溯至施坚雅（G. W. Skinner）在《中华帝国晚期的城市》中颇具影响力的导论章节的共识，过度聚焦于贯穿帝国全时期的县，而忽略了其他朝代特有的地方行政类型。北宋时期（960-1127年），在以乡村为主的县之外，国家建立了多种替代性地方行政类型，其中最显著的是管理城市居民的镇。在1084年存在的约1900个镇中，约30%由中央任命的官僚管理。这些官员负责征税、提供基本公共服务、与民众日常互动，并直接对府级长官负责。忽视这些镇的存在，不仅会低估宋代地方行政的规模，也会低估其复杂性。与后世朝代不同，宋代在行政上区分了城市与乡村聚落，其城市覆盖范围直至近代才被超越。我们将宋代制度的早熟性追溯至宋前两个世纪政治分裂时期的制度创新。

abstract: The United States and China put parts of the global economy at risk in 2025 through their trade war over critical minerals and technology. A series of escalatory tariffs and export restrictions led to shortages of essential inputs, nearly forcing automakers worldwide to shut down production. The costly policies reflected uncoordinated and uncommunicated efforts by both countries to reduce their mutual economic dependence. This paper explores a novel path for the United States and China to "cooperate" over how they reduce their dependence on each other in technology and critical minerals, with the aim of limiting future escalation risks and avoiding unnecessary costs. The proposal draws on a version of the reciprocal approach to negotiations developed under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, modified to accommodate a mutual reduction in each country's market dominance in key sectors.
abstract_zh: 2025年，美国与中国围绕关键矿产和技术的贸易战使全球经济面临风险。一系列不断升级的关税和出口限制导致关键投入品短缺，几乎迫使全球汽车制造商停产。这些代价高昂的政策反映了两国在减少相互经济依赖方面缺乏协调与沟通的努力。本文探索了一条美中两国在技术和关键矿产领域“合作”减少相互依赖的新路径，旨在限制未来升级风险并避免不必要的成本。该提议借鉴了《关税与贸易总协定》框架下发展出的互惠谈判方式，并加以调整，以适应两国在关键领域市场主导地位的共同削减。

abstract: This paper explores factors driving the internationalization of Renminbi (RMB) trading, using data from the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey of global foreign exchange turnover. We analyze both short-term (three-year) trading growth and long-term RMB turnover levels across jurisdictions. Unlike recent studies that struggled to identify sizable effects of real or financial links with China, we find that financial factors, especially banking links with China, play a key role, even over short horizons. These financial links reinforce market-driven "convergence" patterns, whereby RMB trading adjusts based on its under- or over-representation in total currency trading in a given location. However, this convergence is slower than previously reported, while financial drivers have grown in importance. For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区人民币交易的短期（三年）增长与长期交易规模。与近期难以发现与中国实体或金融联系具有显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）即使在短期内也发挥关键作用。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比偏低或偏高进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度慢于此前报告，而金融驱动因素的重要性有所上升。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，但贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易更为显著，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。

abstract: We study how land market frictions affect men and women differently during structural transformation, exploiting two major Chinese land reforms that strengthened farmers' rental rights. Using large-language-model text analysis, we construct a county-level reform index and combine it with large panel data to identify causal effects. The reforms shift rural women out of agriculture more than men and reduce urban women's employment and wages relative to men. A multisector model with intra-household labor allocation rationalizes these findings: gender-neutral land market frictions act as gender-specific mobility barriers, and their removal disproportionately accelerates women's transition into non-agricultural employment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究土地市场摩擦如何在中国结构转型过程中对男性和女性产生差异化影响，利用两项强化农民租赁权的重大土地改革。通过大语言模型文本分析，我们构建了县级改革指数，并结合大规模面板数据识别因果效应。改革使农村女性比男性更大幅度地脱离农业，同时降低了城市女性相对于男性的就业率和工资。一个包含家庭内部劳动力分配的多部门模型解释了这些发现：性别中性的土地市场摩擦充当了性别特定的流动障碍，其消除不成比例地加速了女性向非农就业的转型。

abstract: This paper evaluates the unintended consequences of China's 2021 "Double Reduction" policy, which aimed to ease students' academic burden by limiting homework and private tutoring. Using a tailored household survey, a constructed policy enforcement index, and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy increased private tutoring enrollment, household tutoring expenditures, and parental time spent on helping children with schoolwork. These effects disproportionately harmed low-income families, resulting in worse academic outcomes. Our findings suggest that the policy's effects run counter to its intended goals and may exacerbate educational inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国2021年“双减”政策的非预期后果，该政策旨在通过限制作业和校外培训来减轻学生学业负担。利用定制化家庭调查、构建的政策执行指数以及双重差分设计，我们发现该政策增加了校外培训参与率、家庭培训支出以及家长辅导孩子功课的时间投入。这些效应不成比例地损害了低收入家庭，导致其学业表现恶化。研究结果表明，该政策的实际效果与其预期目标背道而驰，并可能加剧教育不平等。

abstract: Politische Bemühungen, Unternehmen zu einem sog. De-Risking in Bezug auf chinesische Zulieferungen zu veranlassen, zeigen bisher nur geringen Erfolg. Diese Studie untersucht auf Basis von Verbands- und Unternehmensinterviews mögliche Gründe für ein ausbleibendes De-Risking, insbesondere bei mittelständischen Unternehmen. Es zeigt sich, dass sich die Unternehmen der Risiken einer Abhängigkeit durchaus bewusst sind, dass Maßnahmen zur Abhängigkeitsreduktion aber an konkreten Hindernissen (z. B. regulatorische Hürden, Kosten) scheitern.
abstract_zh: 目前，促使企业对中国供应链实施所谓"去风险化"的政治努力成效甚微。本研究基于行业协会与企业访谈，探讨了企业（尤其是中小企业）未能实施去风险化的可能原因。研究发现，企业虽充分认识到依赖风险，但降低依赖度的措施却因具体障碍（如监管壁垒、成本问题）而难以落实。

abstract: We estimate finite-dimensional parameters in conditional moment restriction (CMR) models when at least one of the endogenous variables (outcomes and/or explanatory variables) in the model is missing for some individuals in the sample. We demonstrate that efficiency gains in estimation occur if and only if there is at least one endogenous variable—included in or excluded from the CMR model—that is nonmissing (observed for all individuals in the sample), which we show characterizes informative imputation. We propose a semiparametrically efficient estimator which is also “doubly robust.” To illustrate the insights our estimator can provide in empirical applications with large sample sizes, we artificially induce missingness in the female labor supply model of Angrist and Evans. Despite medium levels of missingness in female labor income (the outcome) and a sample size exceeding 200,000 observations, the inverse propensity score weighted generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator finds only a statistically insignificant negative effect of having a third child (the endogenous regressor) on labor income. In contrast, our efficient estimator yields point estimates of this effect that are not only comparable to the GMM estimates but are also statistically significant.
title: Missing Endogenous Variables in Conditional Moment Restriction Models

abstract: Key Takeaways - A small group of large firms dominates the global petrochemical industry, with ownership heavily concentrated among corporations and geographically in China, the United States, and Saudi Arabia. - Ownership does not equal control. Chinese and other Asian investors exert significant control, while US investors exercise limited control due to reliance on passive investments. Saudi Arabia has full control over its investments. - Europe has weak control and limited presence in the petrochemical industry, with very few major companies, leaving it more dependent on external suppliers. Petrochemicals--used in everything from fertilizers, solar panels, clothing, and cosmetics to electric vehicles, electronics, and medicines--are integral to food security, manufacturing, and clean energy. They are also becoming the fastest-growing source of demand for oil. The 2026 conflict in the Middle East has exposed vulnerabilities in petrochemical supply chains, especially since Middle Eastern producers account for much of the global supply of key petrochemical products, including fertilizers, and one-third of global seaborne fertilizer trade transits the Strait of Hormuz. Understanding the petrochemical industry, including its size, geographical distribution, and ownership and control structure, is essential to reduce risks from geopolitical shocks, hostile takeovers, and fragile supply chains.
abstract_zh: 关键要点 - 少数大型企业主导着全球石化行业，所有权高度集中于企业层面，地理上则集中在中国、美国和沙特阿拉伯。 - 所有权不等于控制权。中国及其他亚洲投资者施加显著控制，而美国投资者因依赖被动投资，控制力有限。沙特阿拉伯对其投资拥有完全控制权。 - 欧洲在石化行业中的控制力薄弱且存在感有限，主要企业极少，因此更依赖外部供应商。 石化产品——用于化肥、太阳能板、服装、化妆品、电动汽车、电子产品及药品等——对粮食安全、制造业和清洁能源至关重要。它们也正成为石油需求增长最快的来源。2026年的中东冲突暴露了石化供应链的脆弱性，尤其是中东生产商占全球关键石化产品（包括化肥）供应的大部分，而全球海运化肥贸易的三分之一需通过霍尔木兹海峡。理解石化行业，包括其规模、地理分布以及所有权与控制结构，对于降低地缘政治冲击、恶意收购和脆弱供应链带来的风险至关重要。

abstract: We use an algorithm audit of China's four largest job boards to measure the causal effect of a job seeker's gender on the jobs that are recommended to them, and to identify the algorithmic processes that generate those recommendations. Focusing on identical male and female worker profiles seeking jobs in the same industry-occupation cell, we find precisely estimated but modest amounts of gender bias: Jobs recommended to women pay 0.2 percent less, request 0.9 percent less experience, come from smaller firms, and contain .07 standard deviations more stereotypically female content such as requests for patience, carefulness, and beauty. The dominant driver of these gender gaps is content-based matching between posted job ads and the declared gender in new workers' resumes. 'Action-based' mechanisms -based on a worker's own actions or recruiters' reactions to their resume- contribute relatively little to the gaps we measure.
abstract_zh: 我们通过对中国四大招聘平台的算法审计，测量求职者性别对推荐岗位的因果效应，并识别产生这些推荐的算法过程。聚焦于在同一行业-职业单元中求职的男女工人档案（特征完全相同），我们发现了精确估计但程度适中的性别偏差：推荐给女性的岗位薪资低0.2%，经验要求低0.9%，来自规模较小的企业，且包含多0.07个标准差的刻板女性化内容（如要求耐心、细心、美貌）。这些性别差距的主要驱动因素是招聘广告与新人简历中声明的性别之间的基于内容的匹配。基于工人自身行为或招聘方对其简历反应的"行动型"机制，对我们所测量的差距贡献相对较小。

abstract: President Donald Trump's Global Tariff War has discarded US commitments to the postwar international trading order established under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) and the World Trade Organization (WTO). It replaces the Most Favored Nation (MFN) principle with an "Every Nation Different" principle under the false premise that any economy with a trade surplus against the United States must be cheating on its trade obligations and imposes a "reciprocal" tariff increase based on the ratio of bilateral US imports to exports. It fails to recognize the role of US fiscal deficits in boosting demand for imports, and of the attractiveness of the US capital market to inflows of foreign capital in strengthening the dollar and contributing to a persistent trade deficit. The Trump Global Tariff War promises revival of US manufacturing jobs under the false premise that trade deficits rather than technological change and Engel curve shifts in demand toward services have driven the decline in the share of manufacturing in employment and GDP. It shows no recognition that higher tariffs are a self-inflicted wound to the economy because of large static welfare triangle costs and loss in dynamic efficiency growth. This study estimates that the 18 percent rise in tariffs so far in the Trump Global Tariff War imposes an ongoing future static welfare cost of 0.28 percent of GDP. The medium-term dynamic efficiency loss brings the total welfare loss reaching a range of 1.1 to 2.3 percent of baseline GDP by 2035. Congressional Budget Office budget estimates of increased tariff revenues of 1 percent of GDP over the next decade (including interest savings) may be understated on an implied premise of sharp import reductions but overstated because President Trump has suggested giving them away in "tariff dividend" checks to all but high-income households. Moreover, a possible Supreme Court ruling against application of the "emergency" legislation on which the main tariff increases are based further reduces the reliability of revenue estimates. The Trump Global Tariff War has usefully revealed a vulnerability of the US economy to a future cutoff in the supply of rare earth minerals, metals, and magnets imported from China that requires urgent action.
abstract_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的全球关税战抛弃了美国在《关税与贸易总协定》（GATT）和世界贸易组织（WTO）框架下对战后国际贸易秩序的承诺。它以"每个国家都不同"原则取代最惠国待遇（MFN）原则，其错误前提是任何对美贸易顺差经济体必然违反贸易义务，并基于双边美进口与出口比率实施"对等"关税加征。该政策未能认识到美国财政赤字对进口需求的拉动作用，以及美国资本市场对外资流入的吸引力如何强化美元并导致持续贸易逆差。特朗普全球关税战承诺重振美国制造业就业，其错误前提是贸易逆差而非技术变革及恩格尔曲线向服务需求转移导致了制造业在就业与GDP中占比下降。该政策完全无视更高关税因巨大的静态福利三角形成本与动态效率增长损失而对经济造成的自伤效应。本研究估算，特朗普全球关税战迄今18%的关税加征将产生持续的未来静态福利成本，占GDP的0.28%。中期动态效率损失使总福利损失在2035年达到基准GDP的1.1%至2.3%区间。美国国会预算办公室关于未来十年关税收入增加GDP的1%（含利息节省）的预算估算，可能因隐含进口大幅减少的前提而被低估，但亦因特朗普总统提议向除高收入家庭外的所有群体发放"关税红利"支票而被高估。此外，最高法院可能裁定主要关税加征所依据的"紧急状态"立法不适用，进一步降低了收入估算的可靠性。特朗普全球关税战有效揭示了美国经济未来面临从中国进口的稀土矿物、金属及磁材供应中断的脆弱性，亟需采取紧急行动。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Trump's global tariff war: Faulty premises, costly consequences
title_zh: 特朗普的全球关税战：错误的前提，高昂的代价

abstract: Multipolarity has become a central but, at the same time, highly ambiguous point of reference in debates about the future world order. The term is used descriptively, that is, to describe shifts in the distribution of power; and it is also used normatively, as an aspirational construct for a more just international order. However, as the following comparative analysis of seven countries shows, there is no coherent understanding of the term even in those countries that are pushing for multipolarity. Sharp dividing lines are evident between the United States, which has long understood the construct of multipolarity as being at odds with its strategic interests, and Russia and China, which both associate it with challenging US hegemony. However, while Russia is striving for a disruptive and violent transformation, China is aiming for an evolutionary one. Other states - above all, India and South Africa - hope that multipolarity will provide them with greater foreign-policy room for manoeuvre. And some derive their own reform proposals at the multilateral level from their understanding of the construct. Germany and the EU must rigorously examine the various interpretations and uses of the construct of multipolarity. They should not dismiss the term as irrelevant or inherently anti-Western as it can provide a common frame of reference on international politics. At the same time, its unreflective use carries risks, as the term is highly politicised and associated with what are at times the conflicting goals of a broad range of international actors. Rather than simply participating in conceptual debates, Germany and the EU should take concrete steps towards reforming the international order in policy areas such as trade, health, energy and climate. At the same time, they should regard the call for multipolarity as an indicator of the need for broad reforms of the international system and initiate negotiation processes with other states. To this end, they must first establish their own reference points with regard to the future international order so that they can identify suitable partners and institutions.
abstract_zh: 多极化已成为未来世界秩序辩论中的核心概念，但同时也极具模糊性。该术语既被用于描述性语境——描述权力分配的变化，也被用于规范性语境——作为构建更公正国际秩序的愿景。然而，对七个国家的比较分析表明，即便在推动多极化的国家中，对该术语的理解也缺乏一致性。美国长期将多极化视为与其战略利益相悖的建构，而俄罗斯和中国则将其与挑战美国霸权相联系，两者之间存在明显分歧。但俄罗斯追求的是破坏性暴力转型，中国则致力于渐进式演变。其他国家——尤其是印度和南非——希望多极化能为其外交政策提供更大回旋空间。部分国家还基于自身理解，在多边层面提出改革方案。德国与欧盟必须严格审视多极化建构的各种解读与运用。不应将该术语视为无关紧要或本质反西方而加以摒弃，因为它能为国际政治提供共同参照框架。但若不加反思地使用该术语也存在风险——该概念高度政治化，且与众多国际行为体时而相互冲突的目标相关联。德国与欧盟不应仅参与概念辩论，而应在贸易、卫生、能源和气候等政策领域采取具体措施改革国际秩序。同时，应将多极化呼声视为国际体系亟需全面改革的信号，并启动与其他国家的谈判进程。为此，他们必须首先确立自身对未来国际秩序的参照基准，以便识别合适的合作伙伴与机构。

title: Multipolarities - The world-order visions of others
title_zh: 多极化——他者的世界秩序愿景

abstract: This paper derives a firm‐level threshold, the Herfindahl Neutral Point, from the standard concentration index used in merger review. At this threshold, a marginal expansion leaves the index unchanged. Firms below the threshold reduce concentration when they expand; firms above it increase concentration. We derive exact formulas for discrete capacity additions and define bridging amounts that measure how far each firm sits from the threshold. Applying this framework to monthly federally inspected hog slaughter data from 2004 to 2024, we show that the sharp rise in concentration in 2016 is driven by acquisitions at firms that were near the threshold and then crossed it, while the subsequent partial decline reflects sustained growth among mid‐tier packers operating below it. The 2015 acquisition of Cargill's pork business illustrates how bridging amounts organize merger analysis within a standard concentration screen. Reallocating the $34.7 million in federal capacity grants awarded to hog‐sector processors under a targeting rule based on this threshold lowers the 2024 national hog packing Herfindahl–Hirschman Index by about 147 points relative to the pre‐award baseline. The framework requires only market shares and the baseline concentration index.
abstract_zh: 本文从并购审查中使用的标准集中度指数出发，推导出一个企业层面的阈值——赫芬达尔中性点。在该阈值处，边际扩张不会改变指数值。低于该阈值的企业扩张时会降低集中度；高于该阈值的企业扩张则会提高集中度。我们推导出离散产能增加的确切公式，并定义了衡量每个企业距离该阈值远近的“桥梁量”。将该分析框架应用于2004年至2024年联邦月度生猪屠宰数据，我们发现2016年集中度的急剧上升是由接近阈值并随后跨越该阈值的企业收购所驱动，而随后的部分下降则反映了在该阈值以下运营的中型加工企业的持续增长。2015年嘉吉猪肉业务的收购案例展示了“桥梁量”如何在标准集中度筛查框架内组织并购分析。基于该阈值的目标规则，将联邦向生猪行业加工商提供的3470万美元产能拨款重新分配，可使2024年全国生猪屠宰赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数相较于拨款前基线降低约147点。该框架仅需市场份额和基线集中度指数。
title: The Herfindahl neutral point: A firm‐level threshold for managing market concentration with evidence from US hog packing
title_zh: 赫芬达尔中性点：基于美国生猪加工企业数据的市场集中度管理阈值

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of common ownership on platform competition with price parity clauses (PPCs). We develop a model of two competing platforms and a multi-homing seller. While common ownership typically raises prices and reduces welfare without PPCs, it lowers platform fees and consumer prices under PPCs. As a result, it increases platform and seller profits, consumer surplus, and total welfare, generating a Pareto improvement.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了共同所有权在价格平价条款（PPCs）下对平台竞争的影响。我们构建了一个包含两个竞争平台和一个多归属卖家的模型。在没有PPCs的情况下，共同所有权通常会提高价格并降低福利；而在PPCs存在时，它则降低了平台费用和消费者价格。因此，共同所有权增加了平台和卖家的利润、消费者剩余及总福利，实现了帕累托改进。
title: Platform competition with common ownership and price parity clauses
title_zh: 共同所有权与价格平价条款下的平台竞争

abstract: We study the tension between price and financial stability from a novel perspective: central bank asset purchases for financial stability during monetary policy tightening. We use as context a rare natural experiment, the 2022 UK gilt crisis, and develop a DSGE model featuring Non-Bank Financial Institutions to replicate the crisis and policy response. We find that asset purchases restore market functioning, and their temporary nature is crucial for avoiding a trade-off with monetary policy. Alternative tools such as repo loans and liquidity buffers can achieve the same goal with reduced impact on the central bank balance sheet. Our results show that central banks can ease financial market stress without loosening monetary policy, delivering on both objectives at all times.
abstract_zh: 我们从一个新的视角研究价格稳定与金融稳定之间的张力：在货币政策紧缩期间，中央银行出于金融稳定目的进行的资产购买。我们以2022年英国国债危机这一罕见的自然实验为背景，构建了一个包含非银行金融机构的DSGE模型，以复现该危机及政策应对。我们发现，资产购买能够恢复市场功能，而其临时性对于避免与货币政策产生权衡至关重要。替代工具，如回购贷款和流动性缓冲，可以在减少对中央银行资产负债表影响的同时实现相同目标。我们的结果表明，中央银行可以在不放松货币政策的情况下缓解金融市场压力，从而在任何时候都能同时实现这两个目标。
title: Monetary policy consequences of financial stability interventions: Assessing the UK gilt crisis and the central bank policy response
title_zh: 金融稳定干预的货币政策后果：评估英国金边债券危机与央行政策应对

abstract: Exploiting a 1960s government trial in Copenhagen, we study the long-run effects of preventive health care for toddlers. We combine administrative data with handwritten nurse records to document universal treatment take-up. Treated children enjoy a five percent of a standard deviation increase in a good adult health index. While initial trial cohorts experience positive health and labour market impacts, those are absent for the final cohorts. Impacts are largest for children with initial health disadvantage and females, and we identify childhood health improvements as a core mechanism. The heterogeneity of trial effects across individuals’ initial health status and cohorts documents that universal toddler care can alleviate health inequalities at low costs, and that the counterfactual policy environment matters.
abstract_zh: 利用20世纪60年代在哥本哈根开展的一项政府试验，我们研究了幼儿预防性医疗保健的长期影响。我们将行政数据与手写护士记录相结合，记录了普遍的治疗接受情况。接受治疗的儿童在成年健康综合指数上提高了0.05个标准差。尽管最初的试验队列在健康和劳动力市场方面产生了积极影响，但最终队列并未观察到这些影响。对于初始健康状况较差的儿童和女性，影响最为显著，并且我们确定儿童期健康状况改善是核心机制。试验效果因个体初始健康状况和队列而异，这表明普遍的幼儿保健能够以低成本缓解健康不平等，且反事实政策环境至关重要。
title: Universal Investments in Toddler Health. Learning from a Large Government Trial
title_zh: 幼儿健康的普遍投资：来自一项大型政府试验的启示

abstract: This paper investigates whether tax evasion opportunities can increase tax revenue. Past theoretical discussions have presented mixed outcomes as to whether allowing taxpayers to opt into uncertainty could indeed enhance overall tax revenues. In this study, we conducted a series of original real-effort experiments in an online setting with almost 6,000 participants to test this hypothesis empirically. Our findings show significant positive labour supply responses to the opportunity to evade (increased labour supply by 30%). More importantly, the expected tax revenue significantly and substantially increased by up to 40%. Strikingly, this effect persists when comparing effective tax rates: Lowering effective tax rates through probabilistic enforcement (the opportunity to evade) is more efficient than simply lowering statutory tax rates. Our findings suggest that the opportunity for tax evasion can increase tax revenues beyond what a corresponding decrease in nominal rates would achieve.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨逃税机会能否增加税收收入。以往的理论讨论对于允许纳税人选择不确定性是否确实能提高整体税收收入，得出了相互矛盾的结果。在本研究中，我们通过在线环境开展了一系列原创的真实努力实验，涉及近6000名参与者，以实证检验这一假设。研究结果显示，逃税机会显著激发了劳动供给的正向反应（劳动供给增加30%）。更重要的是，预期税收收入显著且大幅增长，增幅高达40%。引人注目的是，在比较有效税率时，这一效应依然存在：通过概率性执法（即逃税机会）降低有效税率，比单纯降低法定税率更为高效。我们的发现表明，逃税机会带来的税收收入增长，可能超过相应名义税率下调所能实现的效果。
title: The Bright Side of Tax Evasion
